title: Pricing Schedule: Contract-Value Base for Customer Remake Charges — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Schedule.** For Factory Production Orders, the charge base of a customer specification remake is set by the window contract the order builds:

1. when its contract price divided by its opening count is **at least 2000 dollars**, the base is **25 percent** of that average price per opening for each unit remade;
2. when the average is **below 2000 dollars** and the contract carries an **exterior color** change order, the base is the class remake charge per unit times the units remade plus a paint-line setup charge of **120 dollars**;
3. otherwise the base is the class remake charge per unit times the units remade.

The charge base is the amount the charge for the remake is figured on, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Records read

From the Window Replacement Contracts record of the contract the order builds: the contract price (the signed price after any discount program, including options chosen at signing), the opening count, and whether any change order of the kind exterior color stands on the contract. The units remade are those on the remake record.

## Threshold on both sides (hypothetical contracts)

| Contract price | Openings | Average per opening | Exterior color change order | Base for 2 units remade (Custom Size Build, class charge 189.00) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 24,000.00 | 12 | 2,000.00 | — | 25 percent of 2,000.00 for each of 2 units, 1,000.00 |
| 23,988.00 | 12 | 1,999.00 | yes | 2 units at 189.00 plus 120.00, 498.00 |
| 23,988.00 | 12 | 1,999.00 | no | 2 units at 189.00, 378.00 |
| 30,000.00 | 10 | 3,000.00 | yes | 25 percent of 3,000.00 for each of 2 units, 1,500.00 |

An average of exactly 2,000 dollars falls in the first band; the exterior color change order matters only below it.
